objective_notes.family_temper_s: maximum leave-one-out likelihood of the donors' green first stops under the first-stop distribution the heterogeneous rival field implies
objective_notes.rival_field_mode: hetero is kept when its leave-one-out log-likelihood per green first stop is at least the symmetric pack's; the field's own stops decide, never our plan's benchmark
